findings.text: The summary mixes the two seeds: it takes 99 cut and 95 moving-edge from the P100 seed and then says the batch evaluates the moving-edge integral for 113 cells, which is the H200 seed's moving-edge count, so the sentence contradicts itself and the census table below it. It predates this delta but sits in the file the delta edits and reads as the headline claim.

The wall table is still transcribed by hand; only the repaired row was checked and nothing reconciles the table against the logs or against the SVG that is now derived, so the defect this commit fixed (the P100 kernel row carrying the base arm's launch count) can recur silently.

The added assertion compares this module's own stage-window walk against parse_trace's walk of the same trace; both apply the identical window and Memcpy/Memset filter, so it cannot fail for any data and only fires if the two copies are edited apart, and nothing invokes kernel_table.py in run_device.sh so it never runs automatically.

The palette and canvas are hand-rolled and saved through a bare fig.savefig(path) at line 71 rather than nova.media's ink style and its mechanical label check, and #b06a2a is the brown-orange family the plot-style rule discourages; the figure is also not regenerable from any checked-in command, since nothing in run_device.sh invokes plot.py with its new required --run-dir.
